**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 08:37
- [USER] User inquired about how the Preakness coped with reduced spectator attendance during the pandemic.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Preakness Stakes was postponed from May to October 2020 to plan for a safe event.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The number of spectators was limited to 10,000, down from an average of 131,000 in previous years.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Organizers used pods or small groups of seats to control the flow of people and ensure social distancing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mandatory mask-wearing, temperature checks, and health screenings were implemented before entering the venue.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] No general admission tickets were sold; only pre-reserved seating was allowed to avoid overcrowding.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Increased cleaning protocols, hand sanitizer stations, and encouragement of cashless payments were part of the measures taken.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The race was live-streamed on various platforms, including NBC Sports, YouTube, and Twitter.
- [USER] User expressed that it sounded like a lot was done to make the event safe and asked if it still felt fun and exciting with fewer people.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] According to media reports, the Preakness Stakes maintained a fun and exciting atmosphere despite reduced attendance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The audience was enthusiastic, cheering for their favorite horses and enjoying entertainment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Traditional elements like the singing of "Maryland, My Maryland," Black-Eyed Susan cocktails, and the horse race were maintained.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Live performances by popular music artists contributed to a festival vibe.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The limited attendance created a more intimate atmosphere, allowing spectators to see the race and horses up close.
- [USER] User asked if there was a particular horse that stood out during the race.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Swiss Skydiver, a three-year-old filly, won the 2020 Preakness Stakes, becoming the sixth filly to win and the first in over a decade.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Swiss Skydiver defeated the favorite, Authentic, finishing the race in 1:53.28.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Swiss Skydiver was ridden by jockey Robby Albarado and trained by Kenneth McPeek.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Her victory cemented her status as one of the best three-year-old fillies of the year and put her in the running for the Horse of the Year award.
